native_grazing_reproduction.description: Isolated actual pinned RNE f32 Rapier capsule ray; empirical GJK grazing ambiguity, not a certified error bound
native_grazing_reproduction.standalone_rust_source:
use rne_ecs::{World,spawn_named}; use rne_math::{Vec3,Quat}; use rne_world::Transform3; use rne_physics::{RigidBody,RigidBodyType,Collider,ColliderShape,PhysicsBackend,PhysicsWorldDesc,RaycastQuery}; use rne_physics_rapier::RapierBackend;
fn main(){ let mut ecs=World::new(); let actor=spawn_named(&mut ecs,"actor"); ecs.entity_mut(actor).insert((Transform3::from_translation_rotation(Vec3::new(30.851637857146244,0.6,-0.0),Quat::IDENTITY),RigidBody{body_type:RigidBodyType::Fixed,..RigidBody::default()},Collider{shape:ColliderShape::Capsule{half_height_m:0.5,radius_m:1.0},..Collider::default()})); let mut backend=RapierBackend::new(); let world=backend.create_world(PhysicsWorldDesc::default()).unwrap(); backend.sync_from_ecs(&mut ecs,world).unwrap(); let direction=Vec3::new(0.9948469160371359,-0.017452406437283508,-0.09987505775191116); for delta in [-0.001_f64,-0.0001,-0.00005,0.0,0.00005,0.0001,0.001]{let origin=Vec3::new(21.206407390617414+delta*direction.z,0.6,-0.036761813449073345-delta*direction.x); let hits=backend.raycast(world,RaycastQuery{origin_m:origin,direction,max_distance_m:45.0}).unwrap(); println!("{delta:.9} {:?}",hits.iter().map(|h|h.distance_m).collect::<Vec<_>>());}}
